is_it_falling.what_would_make_it_falling: resident-decided experiments driving landings - the coding-tool path from G112 exercised by the resident rather than by Claude - so resident_decided rises against frontier_moves
is_it_falling.why: G114 asks for a metric that is MEASURED AND FALLING. This is the first computation, so there is nothing to compare it against. A trend needs a second reading from a later window; claiming a direction from one point would be the assertion this obligation exists to replace.

metric.reading: 68 frontier moves landed in 16.4 hours and 21 resident-decided experiments ran in the same campaign, so at most 21 of those moves had a resident decision behind them. 69.1% of frontier moves are Claude interventions. The register says 73.7% of recurring OPERATIONS are handed off, which is a different and more optimistic question: an operation can have an owner on disk and still be exercised by Claude on the day.
metric.this_is_an_upper_bound_on_resident_credi: every executed resident experiment is credited as if it drove a landing. Several drove none. The true intervention share is higher than this figure, not lower.
